#Rel Abundances
datList <- NULL 
for(con in unique(seuratM$pat_patho)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratM, pat_patho==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(pat_patho=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}

## plot abundance
ggbarplot(dat_all, x= "pat_patho", y= "percent", fill = "Var1", palette = colclusterName, legend = "right", legend.titel = "cluster", ylab = "frequency")  + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + scale_x_discrete(limits=ordpat_patho)

#Filter for Tcell cluster
filteredTcell <- dat_all%>%
  filter(Var1 == "Tcell")

View(filteredTcell)

#Relative Abundances

datList <- NULL
for(con in unique(seuratM$pat_patho)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratM, pat_patho==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(diseaseCond=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}
## [1]  45706 107936
## [1] 45706 19369
## [1] 45706 21284
## [1] 45706 10756
## [1] 45706  1338
## [1] 45706 40623
dat_all <- do.call("rbind", datList)

ordpat_patho <- c("donorheart", "explant" ,"ACR0", "ACR1R" ,"ACR2R", "ACR3R")

## plot abundance
ggbarplot(dat_all, x= "diseaseCond", y= "percent", fill = "Var1", legend = "right",  palette = colclusterName, legend.titel = "pathology", ylab = "frequency")  + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + scale_x_discrete(limits=ordpat_patho)
